title: F-VARIABLES — six MCP tool contracts
description: Input / output / clarification contracts for the six new MCP tools introduced by feature 011 (Variable management tools). Each tool entry documents the tool's name, its argument schema, its success-response schema, the clarifications it may surface, and the error shapes the LLM should expect.

declare_variable.description: Declare a story-level variable and emit a format-correct setter into the active story's Start passage.

name.description: Variable name. Case-sensitive. Must not collide with the active format's reserved-name set.

initial.description: Initial value. Defaults to null (no setter emitted; declared-only). When provided, a setter is appended to the Start passage.

declared_in.description: Passage name where the initial setter landed (Start typically). null when initial was omitted.

clarifications: No Start passage exists yet → ask the LLM to set_start_passage first.
Variable name already declared → save_first | discard_unsaved | cancel-equivalent: replace_initial | leave_as_is | cancel.

set_variable.description: Add or replace a setter expression for a named variable in a named passage. Idempotent within a passage.

action.description: created when this is a new setter for the name in the passage; replaced when an existing setter was idempotently overwritten.

emitted_block.description: The exact setter substring emitted into the passage.

clarifications: Passage doesn't exist → clarification listing existing passages, parity with link_passages.

read_variable.description: Read-only probe — returns the current declared / set value of a named variable. No side effects.

loaded_without_setter.description: true only when load_story extracted readers but no setter for this name. See research.md R6.

message.description: Returned when the name is not in the registry. NOT a clarification — the LLM can recover with declare_variable.

list_variables.description: Return every declared variable in the active story with usage statistics.

setter_passages.description: Names of passages containing a setter for this variable, in insertion order.

reader_passages.description: Names of passages containing a reader for this variable, in insertion order.

delete_variable.description: Atomically remove every setter and every reader for a named variable from the active story. Honors the dirty-flag guard from feature 010.
clarifications: Active story is dirty and discard_unsaved is not set → save_first | discard_unsaved | cancel (matches load_story / create_story).
Variable not declared → returns error (kind: error, message names the missing variable). Not a clarification.

insert_variable_reader.description: Insert a format-correct reader expression for a named variable into a named passage. Defaults to link-aware placement — immediately before the first trailing [[...]] link block in the passage.

offset.description: Optional explicit character offset within the passage text. When provided, overrides the default link-aware placement.

reader_block.description: The exact reader substring inserted into the passage.

offset.description: Final character offset where the reader was inserted.

clarifications: Passage doesn't exist → clarification listing existing passages.

chapbook.setter_boolean: <name>: <value>     (true | false; not yes | no — see spec clarification Q4)

non_deterministic_fields: Variable.setters[].offset (depends on passage text history; not stable across edits)
